data.title: What Claude can [[make]] for you
data.subtitle: Ask for the format by name, and that's what you get.

cards.title: Word document
cards.text: Reports, letters and summaries, ready to edit.

cards.title: Excel sheet
cards.text: Tables and budgets with formulas that work.
cards.quote: A budget with formulas that update.

cards.title: PowerPoint deck
cards.text: Presentations you can open in PowerPoint.

cards.title: PDF
cards.text: A finished file to send or print. Download it or save to Google Drive.
cards.quote: Give me this as a PDF.

cards.title: Slides
cards.text: Edit slide by slide, present in Claude, export to PowerPoint or PDF.

cards.title: Doc
cards.text: A document beside the chat. Export to Word, PDF or Google Docs.

cards.title: Dashboard
cards.text: Your numbers on one page you can open and share.

cards.title: Small tool
cards.text: A checklist, tracker or quiz you click and use.
cards.quote: A checklist I can tick off.

cards.title: Diagram
cards.text: A flowchart or process map, drawn in the chat on web and desktop.

cards.title: Chart
cards.text: Your numbers as a chart, right in the conversation.

cards.title: Sourced answer
cards.text: Current facts with citations you can click and check.

cards.title: Rewrite
cards.text: Emails, posts and messages in the tone you ask for.
